stories.title: Tool Schema Registration Contract
stories.description: Define and enforce a centralized contract that maps each allowlisted tool to its corresponding Pydantic schema, ensuring every tool has an explicit, registered validation model before it can be dispatched.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration with FastAPI Endpoint
stories.description: Integrate the tool_router into the FastAPI request lifecycle in main.py, ensuring incoming chat requests invoking tools are correctly routed through allowlist validation and dispatch before returning responses.

stories.title: Error Handling and User-Safe Responses
stories.description: Implement standardized error handling within the tool router to capture allowlist violations, validation failures, and execution errors, returning structured, user-safe responses without exposing internal system details.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Test Coverage for Tool Router
stories.description: Expand and validate test coverage for tool routing, including allowlist enforcement, schema validation, tool dispatch, and error handling scenarios, ensuring alignment with existing test patterns.
